text:
Nikhil (Product): quick follow-up from the all-hands pricing section — can someone clarify how credits rollover works for trial accounts vs paid seats?
Sam (Finance): short answer: trials do NOT roll over; paid accounts roll over up to 25% of your monthly allotment for one month.
Nikhil (Product): thanks — is that automatic or opt-in?
Sam (Finance): automatic for paid seats. opt-in is only for enterprise contracted credits (we require SOW).
Maya (Eng): curious about enforcement — if a customer bursts and exceeds quota, do we throttle or fail the request?
Iris (Support): we want predictable behavior for customers — current policy is soft-throttle after quota + burst buffer, with informative 429 body explaining next available capacity.
Nikhil (Product): can we include a minimal example for the 429 response body in docs? would help SDKs.
Sam (Finance): yes, the docs will show the response payload and recommended retry-after semantics.
Ava (CEO): one high-level ask — make sure the messaging to customers is simple: 'rolled over credits expire in 30 days' and 'trial credits are one-time only'. keep it in marketing copy too.
Maya (Eng): putting a sample 429 here so we can reference in the console copy:
```json
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "detail": "Monthly credits exhausted; burst buffer applied. Next available tokens in 42s.",
  "retry_after": 42
}
```
Iris (Support): will we expose per-route quota splits? customers keep asking how to reserve credits for embeddings vs generation.
Sam (Finance): yes, starting next quarter we'll add per-product buckets (embeddings, generation, rerank). existing accounts will see default splits but can request custom allocations via support.
Nikhil (Product): what about demo orgs and internal sandbox orgs? do we want to mirror trial behavior or grant persistent rollover for internal teams?
Ava (CEO): internal sandboxes should be generous but not unlimited. let's give internal teams a larger monthly allotment and allow 50% rollover for internal accounts flagged by SSO group 'redwood-internal'.
quota-bot: Notice: reminder set — update docs page /docs/credits-rollover by 2026-04-05. Assigned: @Nikhil.
Iris (Support): I'll prepare a short support FAQ blurb and link to the doc when it's live.
Maya (Eng): one engineering note — we'll implement burst buffer as token bucket with a 2x multiplier and a 30s decay window. planning PR next week.
Sam (Finance): pricing note — if customers frequently use burst buffer we will surface a recommendation to move to Dedicated with predictable capacity.
Nikhil (Product): great, I'll follow up with a one-pager and a simple diagram for the all-hands recap email.
Ava (CEO): thanks all — this reads actionable. please ping me if any tradeoffs affect SLAs. :thumbsup:
